title: Concept: Affected row count returned to the client
description: A row count from an update or delete statement in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The count tells the caller how many records the statement touched, which lets them probe which identifiers exist without reading them.
applicability: Deployments that render a row count from an update or delete statement into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The count tells the caller how many records the statement touched, which lets them probe which identifiers exist without reading them.
